def air(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for i in range(25,33) for j in range(26,38) if al[i][j]=='B')
def pcol(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    from collections import Counter
    return dict(Counter(al[i][j] for i in range(25,32) for j in range(26,38) if al[i][j] in 'WpO'))
print('before click: air',air(current_frame),'pcol',pcol(current_frame))
# click pitcher center
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':28,'col':31}])
print('after click pitcher: air',air(current_frame),'pcol',pcol(current_frame),'level',current_frame.level)
print('result',last_action_result.get('board_changed'),last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
